The '''Imperial Archaeological Division''' was a division of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they hypothesized that the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] were actually at one time a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Spacer/Legends|spacefarers]].<ref name="SWG:JWS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Explorer|Jawas Were Spacefarers!}} on Tatooine</ref>
